comparison.objective: Remove one bottle from a tight row without disturbing the others.
comparison.physical_skill: Selective grasping and constrained extraction around unstable neighbors.
comparison.success_condition: The red bottle ends upright in the tray while no bottle falls and neighboring bottles remain substantially undisturbed.
comparison.reason: Tests collision-free extraction of an intact object, not deliberate fracture, insert preservation under impact, or recovery of generated fragments.
